average_cost_price_bdt.documented_assumption: Catalog master wholesale list price published in master vendor agreement.
average_cost_price_bdt.leakage_risk_evaluation: Safe under master vendor agreement assumption; if interpreted as empirical weighted average cost across future batches, it would carry mild leakage.
average_cost_price_bdt.recommended_action: Safe to retain as catalog reference attribute.

average_selling_price_bdt.documented_assumption: Catalog manufacturer suggested retail price (MSRP) / national reference price published in master product catalog.
average_selling_price_bdt.leakage_risk_evaluation: Highly correlated (0.99996) with empirical transaction selling prices. Safe under the documented assumption that master catalog reference prices are fixed in advance.
average_selling_price_bdt.recommended_action: Safe to retain in feature matrix alongside outlet-specific shelf price.

outlet_average_daily_demand.documented_assumption: Pre-season retail planning prior / corporate merchandise demand estimate.
outlet_average_daily_demand.leakage_risk_evaluation: In synthetic generation, this parameter is the latent demand mean (corr=0.919 with annual sales). If treated as an empirical post-hoc average, it would constitute full-history leakage. If central planning estimates are available in advance, it is safe as a static baseline prior.
outlet_average_daily_demand.recommended_action: Include as benchmark baseline feature and in linear models. In tree ensembles, perform ablation tests (with vs without) to ensure model does not shortcut learning temporal and local features.
